lines: There's a planet where it rains glass. Sideways.
There's a planet where it rains GLASS. SIDEWAYS.
Sideways? Rain has one job. Down!
SIDEWAYS? Rain has ONE job. DOWN!
Welcome to Orbit Gossip! Today's scandal: planet H D one eight nine, seven three three b.
Welcome to ORBIT GOSSIP! Today's scandal: planet HD 189733b.
That's not a name. That's a wifi password.
That's not a name. That's a WIFI PASSWORD.
Gorgeous though! Deep blue, like Earth. Sixty-three light-years away.
Gorgeous though! Deep BLUE, like Earth. 63 LIGHT-YEARS away.
Blue? So, oceans. Beaches. Tiny umbrellas in drinks?
BLUE? So, oceans. Beaches. Tiny umbrellas in drinks?
Nope. The blue is glass. Little drops of melted glass in the clouds.
Nope. The blue is GLASS. Little drops of MELTED GLASS in the clouds.
So the sky is basically... a chandelier.
So the sky is basically... a CHANDELIER.
A chandelier in a hurricane! Winds up to eight thousand seven hundred kilometres an hour. Seven times the speed of sound!
A chandelier in a HURRICANE! Winds up to 8,700 KM/H. SEVEN TIMES the speed of sound!
So you don't get wet. You get sandblasted. By a window.
So you don't get wet. You get SANDBLASTED. By a WINDOW.
Oh, and it's over a thousand degrees.
Hot, windy, raining glass. One star. Would not visit.
Hot, windy, raining glass. ONE STAR. Would not visit.
And one year there lasts just two point two days.
And one YEAR there lasts just 2.2 DAYS.
Two days?! I'd have a birthday every weekend!
2 DAYS?! I'd have a BIRTHDAY every WEEKEND!
And scientists think one side always faces its star. Endless day on one side, endless night on the other.
And scientists think ONE SIDE always faces its star. Endless DAY on one side, endless NIGHT on the other.
So half the planet never sleeps... and the other half never gets breakfast.
So half the planet NEVER SLEEPS... and the other half never gets BREAKFAST.
Final ratings! Looks: ten out of ten.
Personality: a hurricane full of windows.
Personality: a HURRICANE full of WINDOWS.
So next time it rains on you, say thank you. At least it's falling down.
So next time it rains on you, say THANK YOU. At least it's falling DOWN.
